domainSpecifier: cloud architecture, DevOps, and platform engineering consultancy
oneLineDescription: North Yardley Engineering is a UK technology consultancy providing cloud architecture, DevOps, and platform engineering services to mid-market and enterprise clients.

services.name: Cloud migration
services.description: Provider-agnostic migration services for AWS, GCP, and Azure.

services.name: Platform engineering and internal developer platform design
services.description: Designing and implementing platform engineering and internal developer platforms.

services.name: Observability program design
services.description: Designing SLO/SLA frameworks, error budgets, and alerting hygiene programs.

services.name: DevOps and CI/CD modernisation
services.description: Modernising DevOps practices and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery pipelines.

services.name: Cost optimisation and FinOps program design
services.description: Designing programs for cloud cost optimisation and FinOps.

services.name: Capability uplift
services.description: Improving client team capabilities through embedded mentorship.

targetAudience: UK and Irish technology companies between Series B and post-IPO scale (approximately 100–1,500 engineering headcount), with decision-makers being CTOs, VP Engineering, and Heads of Platform.
uniqueSellingPoints: Written handover documentation as a contractual deliverable on every engagement
All consultants are former practitioners with at least 7 years of in-house experience prior to consulting
The firm publishes a quarterly research letter ("Yardley Quarterly") covering one operational topic in depth
Member of the British Computer Society; founding partners are Chartered IT Professionals
